nl: Run tools/greet.py with the argument Ewa and the environment variable GREETING set to 'Hello' and APP_MODE set to 'service'; save its output to greet-5.txt. Do not store the variables in any file.

entries.content_utf8:
import os
import sys

print(f"{os.environ['GREETING']}, {sys.argv[1]}")
print(f"mode={os.environ.get('APP_MODE', 'default')}")
